build_luna_bert_model: build a LunaBertModel instance using build_model with args and a fairseq task
register_classification_head: register a classification head like pooling_classification_head or attention_classification_head on LunaBertModel
forward_luna_bert: run the forward pass of LunaBertModel with src_tokens and optional classification_head_name
extract_features_luna_encoder: extract features from input tokens using LunaBertEncoder extract_features method
configure_luna_architecture: configure a Luna BERT architecture like luna_base_512 or luna_large_2048 with base_architecture
